EC-K3-DET1236-MARKED-SHIMURA-CURVE.title: Exact determinant-1236 marked Shimura curve and rational-lift gate
EC-K3-DET1236-MARKED-SHIMURA-CURVE.scope: For rootless-MW17 row K3-6d288cfad55e0d15 (legacy NS0035), the primitive transcendental lattice has Gram [[-2,0,1],[0,4,0],[1,0,154]], determinant -1236, and discriminant group Z/1236. Its literal even Clifford order has reduced trace-pairing determinant -618^2 and is an Eichler order of quaternion discriminant 6 and level 103, not merely an order similar to it. Exact normalizer representatives induce all eight elements of O(A_T), while the projectively stable subgroup is {1,w_618}; hence the fully marked period curve is C_1236=X_0^6(103)/<w_618>, not the coarse genus-17 curve X_0^6(103). Riemann--Hurwitz gives C_1236 genus 6, no cusps, twelve order-2 and two order-3 orbifold points. It has a degree-two map to the exact genus-two quotient B: y^2=1944*x^6+441*x^4-90*x^2+9, and EC-K3-DET1236-GENUS2-RATIONAL-POINTS proves that B(QQ) consists of exactly fourteen points. Gonzalez--Rotger residue fields plus the complete class-number-one/two order lists prove that C_1236 has exactly ten rational CM points: two of discriminant -3 and four each of discriminants -43 and -67; the other fixed fibre is a quadratic discriminant -24 CM pair. EC-K3-DET1236-CANDIDATE-DOUBLE-COVER gives an exact characteristic-zero cover candidate, its pullback squareclass, and all twelve conditional fibre evaluations. Four non-fixed B-points have rational fibres for the displayed twist, giving eight conditional lifts, while its -3 twist has none. The eight conditional lifts plus the two fixed points exhaust the complete rational CM locus, so all are CM; their required existence on the actual curve rules out the no-lift twist once the candidate branch divisor is identified. The Phase-2 status remains UNRESOLVED_FOR_EXPLICIT_REASON only because the candidate's cubic branch orbit has not been identified with the order-discriminant -1236 Shimura orbit in characteristic zero. That identification would prove ARITHMETICALLY_EXCLUDED, not realizable. No NS reconstruction or K3 equation work is authorized.

EC-K3-DET1236-CANDIDATE-DOUBLE-COVER.title: Exact candidate for the determinant-1236 marked double cover
EC-K3-DET1236-CANDIDATE-DOUBLE-COVER.scope: Let E=618f1 with generator G=(10,-29), K=QQ(a) for a^3-a^2+4a+12=0, and A=(-3a^2-9a-20,15a^2-57a-155). Exact splitting-field addition gives Tr(A)=-16G. The point P=9G+2A has Tr(P)=-5G and x-minimal polynomial X^3-216X^2-6924X-62224 of discriminant -1236*24192^2. Exact class-field arithmetic gives class group C6 x C2 for QQ(sqrt(-1236)); its degree-12 Hilbert class field has three embedded cubic subfields, all of discriminant -1236 and QQ-isomorphic to K. Thus the candidate has the exact unique cubic CM residue-field isomorphism class, although this does not identify the particular point P. Exact L(6O) linear algebra gives b0=-X^3-328X^2-2772X+66512+(32X+1600)Y with divisor (-3G)+Orbit(P)+2(4G)-6O and norm (X-4)(X-58)^2(X^3-216X^2-6924X-62224). The candidate z^2=2b0 has, at p=5,11,13,17,19,23,29,31 and extension degrees one through three, exactly the 618c1*618d1 Prym traces; multiplying by h=(X-4)/54 has the complementary 618a1*618b1 traces. Pullback to B is Z^2=3(-81x^6-534x^4+8x^2y-177x^2+8y+24). Exact local-unit evaluation of all twelve non-fixed rational points gives rational normalization fibres precisely at (+/-1,48) and (+/-1/3,8/3), eight conditional rational lifts in total; the -3 twist gives none. Independently, Gonzalez--Rotger residue fields and the complete class-number-one/two order lists prove that the actual marked curve has exactly ten rational CM points, with multiplicities 2,4,4 for discriminants -3,-43,-67. Thus all eight conditional non-fixed lifts are CM, and their existence rules out the no-lift twist after the branch divisor is identified. The status is UNRESOLVED_FOR_EXPLICIT_REASON only because the field match and finitely many exact Euler factors do not prove that the particular point P is the order-discriminant -1236 Shimura CM branch image. If that identification is proved, this certificate gives ARITHMETICALLY_EXCLUDED.

EC-K3-NS0031-MARKED-SOURCE-PRECURSOR.title: Exact marked finite-field and finite-lift source precursor for NS0031
EC-K3-NS0031-MARKED-SOURCE-PRECURSOR.scope: For the artifact-qualified source key (elkies-k3-lattice-foundry-prescribed-root-sources-all-ns-3e8-all-a-v1.json, NS0031-S001), the semistable A1+2A7/MW2 source has exact height Gram [[2,1],[1,41/8]] and complete-basis pole profile [0,1]. The complete normalized GF(7) square-twist chart contains two correctly paired marked MW2 bases on model 157. At one pair, all 59 fibre, section, and component-jet equations vanish; the 52-variable Jacobian has rank 51 with unit maximal minor; and explicit integer coordinates solve all 59 equations modulo 7^8. EC-K3-NS0031-MARKED-RATIONAL-PARAMETER-S.title: Bounded rational-coordinate scan on the NS0031 model-157 formal branch
EC-K3-NS0031-MARKED-RATIONAL-PARAMETER-S.scope: The free formal coordinate at the certified NS0031 model-157 marked branch is m9=1 modulo 7. Every reduced rational m9=n/d with |n|<=40, 1<=d<=40, gcd(n,d)=1, 7 not dividing d, and n/d=1 modulo 7 was tested: 247 values. Each specialization was fixed throughout an exact lift to 7^40, followed by simultaneous rational reconstruction of all 52 coordinates; all 247 rows returned NO_FULL_RR, with no lift error and no claimed QQ-point. Any retained row would additionally have been substituted into all 59 equations and the exact I2+2I8+6I1 open gates. This is a bounded negative calculation only. Rational-reconstruction failure is not a proof of 7-adic irrationality, and the scan neither classifies rational points nor obstructs rational algebraization.

EC-K3-RANK19-ARITHMETIC-MARKING-CLASSIFI.title: Fail-closed arithmetic-marking classifier for rank-19 Neron--Severi lattices
EC-K3-RANK19-ARITHMETIC-MARKING-CLASSIFI.scope: The exact rootless-MW17 subset of the rank-seven catalogue contains 66 candidate rank-19 Neron--Severi lattices. For every row the classifier checks the NS=U+W(-1) rank, signature, determinant, evenness, minimum, and Smith invariants against the catalogue's primitive ternary K3 complement T; imports the exact rational even-Clifford algebra and integral-order ledger; and separates its coarse norm-one curve from the full stable discriminant-kernel marking curve. Hash-pinned decision records classify the determinant-948 NS0001 control as ARITHMETICALLY_POSSIBLE by its exact QQ equation, seventeen rational sections, rho=19, saturation, and trivial torsion; classify determinants 500 and 750, determinant-720 Golay, determinant-950 NS0024, and determinant-1184 NS0031 as ARITHMETICALLY_EXCLUDED by proved modular obstructions; and retain the other 60 rows as UNKNOWN. Within those 60, determinant 1236 has the stronger exact Phase-2 status UNRESOLVED_FOR_EXPLICIT_REASON: EC-K3-DET1236-MARKED-SHIMURA-CURVE identifies its genus-six X_0^6(103)/<w_618> curve, EC-K3-DET1236-GENUS2-RATIONAL-POINTS proves that its genus-two quotient has exactly fourteen rational points, EC-K3-DET1236-RATIONAL-CM-LOCUS proves that the marked curve has exactly ten rational CM points, and EC-K3-DET1236-CANDIDATE-DOUBLE-COVER gives eight conditional non-fixed rational lifts which the complete CM locus forces all to be CM. Only the candidate cubic branch-orbit identification remains; it would convert the row to ARITHMETICALLY_EXCLUDED. The new different-NS equation-agent handoff is empty because UNKNOWN rows are not dispatched. This is not a complete classification of rank-19 NS lattices or a decision for any other unknown marked curve.

EC-K3-ARITHMETIC-FIRST-MARKED-T-FOUNDRY.scope: The Lane B foundry begins with all 827 rank-three transcendental-lattice rows and orders them without using rootless-frame data.
